message: serwist.config.mjs, which controls what the service worker precaches (including the precachePrerendered: false guard on page HTML), is not in human_approval or CODEOWNERS. The service worker cache rules this pass sets out to gate can still change through a bot-approved PR.
The new CLAUDE.md bullet says the list covers the service worker's cache rules, but serwist.config.mjs is not listed, so the doc claims more than the gates enforce.
